## Construct-specific checks

The KSA-3 scale has three facets with three items each: aggression, submission and conventionalism. The table compares one factor with three factors in every wave.

```{r}
fits <- NULL
for (w in 1:5) {
  for (k in c(1, 3)) fits <- rbind(fits, cbind(Wave = w, efa(d[d$wave == w, ], item_names, k)$fit))
}
show_table(fits, digits = 3)
```

**Wave 1 loadings, three factors** (loadings below .30 hidden):

```{r}
show_table(efa(d[d$wave == 1, ], item_names, 3)$loadings)
```
